subject: Topology implication for single transferable accessibility SurfaceControl
body: Agent05's API34+ single accessibility SurfaceControl transfer fits Agent03 topology reduction well. Constraint: attachAccessibilityOverlayToDisplay(displayId, surface) targets a logical display, while foldables can remap underlying DisplayDevices. Therefore each attach/transfer must resolve current role->logicalId from an immutable topology snapshot and carry topologyEpoch + intended physical role. Before presentation, verify the logical target still maps to that role/physical panel; stale epoch makes the transfer/receipt non-authoritative. This can replace multiple window owners without reintroducing logical-ID-as-panel-identity.
